task.protocol: resample paired adaptation seeds and a common image sample; fixed prototypes and initial classifier head

limits: Original models, context images, training-only mapping and original-validation thresholds fixed. Native certainty>=3 labels and the same attribute cohort used for every condition. Twenty-five semantic and twenty-five task intervals are descriptive, unadjusted, paired adaptation seeds/common source images and conditional on this fixed background protocol and one MC8 realization. No test recalibration; mean inference does not retrain the model. Majority foreground pixels are preserved, but compositing/resizing remain synthetic. Banks have different attribute cohorts; do not compare absolute BA across banks. Identity uses the background evaluation sampling seed, not the seed of the clean attribute report.
